gaps.explanation: arrive IN towns, cities and countries; AT for buildings/points.

gaps.sentence: She smiled ___ the waiter and ordered tea.
The press launched an attack ___ the minister's record.
The project failed through a lack ___ funding.
She soon got tired ___ answering the same questions.
gaps.explanation: tired OF something = bored/annoyed by it; tired FROM = physically exhausted.

gaps.sentence: Three workers were involved ___ the accident.
I haven't heard ___ my cousin since Christmas.
gaps.explanation: hear FROM somebody = get a letter/message from them.

gaps.sentence: Everyone laughed ___ his impression of the headmaster.
